    1| --!strict
    2| -- InventoryService [owner: Inventory]. The physical, goofy inventory that replaces the Roblox backpack
    3| -- (docs/game/08 "Inventory"). Gear is real stuff in the world: station GearRacks, truck compartments,
    4| -- the truck's hose reel, and anything dropped or thrown. Slot rules live in ReplicatedStorage/Lib/Items/
    5| -- ItemDefs (spec-tested); the item looks in Lib/Items/ItemProps.
    6| --
    7| -- Slots: HAND (one held item = a Tool under the character, made by ToolService:CreateTool so spraying
    8| --   and the axe keep working), BACK (one backable item, the oxygen tank by default; a welded model on
    9| --   your back), CARRY (a world prop tagged InventoryConfig.CarryTag held in both arms; NPC carry is
   10| --   RescueService's).
   11| --
   12| -- Public API:
   13| --   InventoryService:Give(player, itemId): boolean      -- a fresh item, by the ItemDefs grab rules
   14| --   InventoryService:Drop(player): boolean              -- G: carried prop first, else the hand item
   15| --   InventoryService:Throw(player, aim: Vector3, charge: number): boolean
   16| --   InventoryService:Swap(player): boolean              -- hand <-> back
   17| --   InventoryService:GetHand(player): string?   GetBack(player): string?
   18| --   InventoryService:Clear(player)                      -- silently empties every slot (no drops)
   19| -- Signals: Changed(player), Bonked(thrower: Player, victim: Player, what: string),
   20| --          Fumbled(player, itemId: string)
   21| -- Remotes: Inventory/Drop (C->S, none, 4/s), Inventory/Throw (C->S, aim: unit Vector3, charge: 0..1, 3/s),
   22| --          Inventory/Swap (C->S, none, 4/s), Inventory/Fx (S->C all, kind: string, pos: Vector3, text: string)

  335| local function grabLoose(player: Player, m: Model)

  339| 		return
  340| 	end

  342| 		return

  344| 	local held: Held = { id = info.id, data = info.data }

  346| 	if reel and not reel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then

  357| local function spawnLoose(held: Held, cf: CFrame, velocity: Vector3, thrower: Player?): Model?
  358| 	local def = ItemDefs.get(held.id)
  359| 	if not def then
  360| 		return nil
  361| 	end
  362| 	-- cap: recycle the oldest loose item (never a tethered nozzle if anything else can go)
  363| 	while #looseOrder >= Cfg.MaxLooseItems do
  364| 		local victim = looseOrder[1]
  365| 		for _, m in looseOrder do
  366| 			if not (loose[m] and loose[m].data.reel) then
  367| 				victim = m
  368| 				break
  369| 			end
  370| 		end
  371| 		removeLoose(victim)
  372| 	end
  373| 	local m = ItemProps.build(held.id, "world", 1.15)
  374| 	m.Name = `Loose_{held.id}`
  375| 	m:PivotTo(cf)
  376| 	m:AddTag(TAG_ITEM)
  377| 	local handle = m.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
  378| 	local prompt = invPrompt(handle, `Grab {def.name}`, "", Cfg.GrabDistance)
  379| 	m.Parent = folder()
  380| 	local info: Loose = { id = held.id, data = held.data, born = os.clock() }
  381| 	loose[m] = info
  382| 	table.insert(looseOrder, m)
  383| 	local reel = held.data.reel
  384| 	if reel and reel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
  385| 		local hoseEnd = handle:FindFirstChild("HoseEnd") :: Attachment?
  386| 		if hoseEnd then
  387| 			local rope = Instance.new("RopeConstraint")
  388| 			rope.Name = "HoseTether"
  389| 			rope.Attachment0 = reelAttachment(reel)
  390| 			rope.Attachment1 = hoseEnd
  391| 			rope.Length = hoseLength(reel)
  392| 			rope.Visible = true
  393| 			rope.Thickness = 0.45
  394| 			rope.Color = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
  395| 			rope.Parent = handle
  396| 			info.rope = rope
  397| 		end
  398| 		reelLoose[reel] = m
  399| 	end
  400| 	pcall(function()
  401| 		handle:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
  402| 	end)
  403| 	handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
  404| 	if thrower then
  405| 		local r = Random.new()
  406| 		handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(r:NextNumber(-1, 1), r:NextNumber(-1, 1), r:NextNumber(-1, 1)) * Cfg.ThrowSpin
  407| 		addFlyer(handle, thrower, def.name)
  408| 	end
  409| 	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
  410| 		grabLoose(player, m)
  411| 	end)
  412| 	return m
  413| end

  435| local function equipHand(player: Player, ps: PState)
  436| 	if ps.toolFor == ps.hand and (ps.tool == nil or ps.tool.Parent ~= nil) then
  437| 		return
  438| 	end
  439| 	local old = ps.toolFor
  440| 	if ps.tool then
  441| 		local t = ps.tool
  442| 		ps.tool = nil
  443| 		t:Destroy()
  444| 	end
  445| 	if old and old ~= ps.hand then
  446| 		releaseHose(player, old)
  447| 	end
  448| 	ps.toolFor = ps.hand
  449| 	local held = ps.hand
  450| 	local char = player.Character
  451| 	if not held or not char then
  452| 		return
  453| 	end
  454| 	local def = ItemDefs.get(held.id)
  455| 	local tool: Tool? = nil
  456| 	if def and def.tool then
  457| 		local made = call("ToolService", "CreateTool", held.id, player)
  458| 		if typeof(made) == "Instance" and (made :: Instance):IsA("Tool") then
  459| 			tool = made :: Tool
  460| 		end
  461| 	end
  462| 	local t = tool or ItemProps.tool(held.id)
  463| 	t:SetAttribute("InvItem", held.id)
  464| 	ps.tool = t
